revenue_source: Screener.in company page (screener.in/company/UMANGDAIRY/consolidated/), Profit & Loss table, standalone figures: Sales Mar 2025 = 228 Rs Cr (Mar 2024 = 286, Mar 2023 = 293). FY26 (Mar 2026) not yet reported at time of check - null.
note: Registry data NOT verified: searx web_search was down (connection refused) and all registry aggregators (ZaubaCorp, TheCompanyCheck, Moneycontrol) returned HTTP 403; Google/DuckDuckGo blocked or timed out. Therefore CIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, registered-office state and MCA status are all null - not public via accessible sources in this session, not invented. What IS confirmed: the entity exists and is listed (NSE: UMANGDAIRY, BSE 500231), Screener.in page title reads 'Umang Dairies Ltd(Merged)' and describes it as incorporated in 1994, part of J.K. Organisation, promoted by Bengal and Assam Co Ltd, manufacturing dairy products (cheese, butter, ghee, cream, milk powder, flavoured milk, lassi, curd) with own plants and job-work activity - hence role = manufacturer (not trader). Official site umangdairies.com is live and presents itself as 'Umang Dairies Limited - Best Dairy Company in Delhi' with an Exports section and Institutional/Private Label businesses; note the site footer still says 'Umang Daries Pvt. Ltd' (legacy/typo), while the listed entity is a Limited company. The '(Merged)' tag on Screener suggests a merger/amalgamation event - MCA status must be re-checked on mca.gov.in before any decision; no rejection is warranted on current evidence since the entity demonstrably exists and trades. Declared HS 040210 (milk powder) is consistent with the company's stated SMP/WMP product lines, but HS was not the object of this check. State claimed in input was empty, so no state mismatch can be assessed. Revenue FY25 228 Cr is from a financial data aggregator reproducing audited standalone P&L, not read directly from the annual report PDF - treat as indicative; FY26 null.
